locations.name: Proving Courtyard
locations.description: Flagstones worn smooth by generations of travelers ring a warm stone hearth. Warden Halrik oversees recruits beneath the emerald-and-gold banner while Quartermaster Sera tends the supply awning.

connections.label: Climb NE to Ember Forge Terrace
Follow NW path to Whispering Grove
Take SE road to Old Watchtower Ruins
Ascend S trail to Proving Beacon Cliff

actions.label: Practice Stance at Sparring Post
actions.description: Test your timing in the Courtyard Sparring Brace minigame.

narrative.overview: Flagstones worn smooth by generations of travelers ring a warm stone hearth. Warden Halrik oversees recruits beneath the emerald-and-gold banner while Quartermaster Sera tends the supply awning.

locations.name: Ember Forge Terrace
locations.description: Open-air stone anvils, herbal drying racks, and brass caliper benches overlook the sea. Artisan Brann keeps the crucible embers glowing for recruits learning crafting and field combinations.

connections.label: Cross N ridge to Whispering Grove
Descend SE toward Old Watchtower Ruins

actions.label: Work the Ember Terrace Anvil
actions.description: Practice hammer timing at the forge anvil minigame.

narrative.overview: Open-air stone anvils, herbal drying racks, and brass caliper benches overlook the sea. Artisan Brann keeps the crucible embers glowing for recruits learning crafting and field combinations.

locations.name: Whispering Grove
locations.description: Tall coastal pines sway above a mossy stream and a lantern-carved roadside shrine. Sunleaf grows thick along the creek banks, though wolf tracks wind through the bracken.

connections.label: Take E ridge trail to Ember Forge Terrace

actions.label: Cast Travel-Lots at Wayfarer Shrine
actions.description: Make a small gesture at the shrine to try the Wayfarer Bone-Cast minigame.

actions.label: Stalk & Forage Sunleaf Trail
actions.description: Move quietly along the pine creek to gather herbs via the stalking minigame.

hiddenSpots.name: Hollow Cedar Root Cache
hiddenSpots.text: Tucked inside a dry cedar root hollow wrapped in oiled canvas lies the Signet of the First Warden!

narrative.overview: Tall coastal pines sway above a mossy stream and a lantern-carved roadside shrine. Sunleaf grows thick along the creek banks, though wolf tracks wind through the bracken.

locations.name: Old Watchtower Ruins
locations.description: Weathered grey stone walls frame a broken watchtower overlooking the eastern reefs. A rune-carved archway stands intact beside an ironbound chest, while scavengers lurk among the rubble.

connections.label: Climb NW to Ember Forge Terrace
Follow coastal path SW to Proving Beacon Cliff

actions.label: Examine the Rune-Carved Archway
actions.description: Inspect the ancient inscription to solve the Watchtower riddle.

hiddenSpots.name: Loose Masonry Niche
hiddenSpots.text: Behind a loose keystone you find a pouch of fresh Sunleaf and Ember Resin.

narrative.overview: Weathered grey stone walls frame a broken watchtower overlooking the eastern reefs. A rune-carved archway stands intact beside an ironbound chest, while scavengers lurk among the rubble.

locations.name: Proving Beacon Cliff
locations.description: Sea wind whips across a flat limestone promontory where a great iron signal brazier overlooks the Wayfarer Sea. Lighting this beacon marks the final step of every recruit's proving.

connections.label: Follow cliff path NE to Old Watchtower Ruins

actions.label: Ignite the Wayfarer Beacon
actions.description: Strike the Consecrated Beacon Flint to kindle the great coastal brazier.

transcript.speaker: Wayfarer Beacon
transcript.text: Bright emerald-gold fire roars upward from the cliff brazier, visible across the entire Proving Isle! Return to Warden Halrik in the Courtyard to claim your Charter.

narrative.overview: Sea wind whips across a flat limestone promontory where a great iron signal brazier overlooks the Wayfarer Sea. Lighting this beacon marks the final step of every recruit's proving.
